_meta.name: Real-world XSS regression set (OWASP Juice Shop + DVWA + bWAPP + self-hosted lab)
_meta.purpose: Third-party application targets, scored separately from the self-authored 194-case matrix. v1 covered anonymous Juice Shop surfaces only; v2 adds an authenticated, Docker-safe Juice Shop instance plus DVWA for login-reflected and persistent-comment XSS; v2.1 adds a self-hosted four-face lab; v2.2 adds bWAPP (reflected GET, stored blog, User-Agent header, login).
_meta.detection_contract: a finding whose type is one of reflected/stored/stored_dom/dom/dom_dynamic/header_xss/cookie_xss/path_xss and whose severity is medium/high/critical counts as detection; low-severity reachability hints and non-XSS audits (CORS, XS-Leaks, outdated JS, SQLi) do not

juice_unsafe.name: OWASP Juice Shop (unsafe config)
juice_unsafe.note: NODE_ENV=unsafe loads config/unsafe.yml (challenges.safetyMode=disabled). Docker-disabled challenges (restfulXssChallenge, httpHeaderXssChallenge) are then active; verified against build/models/product.js and build/routes/saveLoginIp.js. Admin session admin@juice-sh.op / admin123.

bwapp.name: bWAPP
bwapp.note: Login bee/bug; security_level=0 (low). The image ships MySQL but needs install.php; after install, official bugs.txt is the ground-truth catalogue. Non-admin user bwuser/bwpass123 was created via the official user_new.php form (admin=0).

selfhosted.name: Self-hosted XSS lab (third-party-style, four faces)
selfhosted.note: Deliberately independent of the 194-case fixture. Reflected /reflect, stored /guestbook (SQLite, shared across sessions), header /header (User-Agent + X-Forwarded-For), login admin/adminpass (admin) and alice/alicepass (user). Safe twins /reflect-safe and /header-safe. Ground truth by construction + independent Playwright dialog check (2026-11-03).

dvwa.name: Damn Vulnerable Web Application
dvwa.start: docker network create dvwa-net; docker run -d --name dvwa-db --network dvwa-net -e MARIADB_ROOT_PASSWORD=rootpass -e MARIADB_DATABASE=dvwa -e MARIADB_USER=dvwa -e MARIADB_PASSWORD=p@ssw0rd mariadb:11; docker run -d --name dvwa-official --network dvwa-net -p 127.0.0.1:8080:80 -e DB_SERVER=dvwa-db -e DEFAULT_SECURITY_LEVEL=low ghcr.io/digininja/dvwa@sha256:1af2cedda7617e4d22937e61c98bbf71d8b74b98e46f5e41dd6aa0a5183311b0
dvwa.note: login admin/password; security level forced to low via security.php. The digest is the real pin; the :latest tag is only what was pulled.
